body_lead: Bengaluru: Karnataka is sharpening its focus on artificial intelligence, data integration and cyber resilience as the state’s Centre for e-Governance (CeG) looks to deepen the reach of digital public services across urban and rural regions alike. In an interaction with ETGovernment, T Bhoobalan, IAS, Chief Executive Officer, Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka, said the state is prioritising infrastructure expansion, in-house technology development, skill upgradation, capacity building and adoption of emerging technologies as part of its roadmap for the new fiscal.
